::: {.about-content}

::: {.about-intro}
Hello! I'm originally from **Dhaka**, the vibrant capital city of Bangladesh. I came to the US in 2015 in pursuit of my bachelor's degree in Computer Science and lived in West Michigan before moving to Northern Virginia in 2022. 

I am currently a **Data Analyst II** at Shift Digital in the Data Operations and Analytics team, where I leverage data-driven solutions for enterprise clients. I graduated with a **Master's of Science in Data Science & Analytics** from Georgetown University in 2025. My passion lies in leveraging tailored data and algorithms to solve intricate business problems and communicating complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.

I love spending time in charming cafes and exploring new cuisines. During my downtime I enjoy reading, painting and watching movies/TV shows.
:::

::: {.section-card}
## 📊 Professional Journey

::: {.journey-visual}
<div id="professional-timeline"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script>
// Professional Timeline Data
const timelineData = [
  {
    id: 1,
    period: "2015-2020",
    title: "Bachelor of Science - Computer Science",
    organization: "Grand Valley State University",
    location: "Grand Rapids, MI",
    type: "education",
    startDate: new Date(2015, 7, 1), // Aug 2015
    endDate: new Date(2020, 4, 31),  // May 2020
    skills: ["Programming", "Data Structures", "Algorithms", "Software Engineering"],
    gpa: "3.8/4.0"
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    period: "2020-2021",
    title: "Computer Engineer",
    organization: "Array of Engineers",
    location: "Grand Rapids, MI",
    type: "professional",
    startDate: new Date(2020, 6, 1), // Jul 2020
    endDate: new Date(2021, 10, 30), // Nov 2021
    skills: ["Avionics Software", "DOORS", "Ansys SCADE", "AngularJS", "A/B Testing"],
    achievements: ["98% on-time delivery", "25% user retention increase"]
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    period: "2021-2023",
    title: "Data Analyst I",
    organization: "Shift Digital",
    location: "Birmingham, MI",
    type: "professional",
    startDate: new Date(2021, 10, 1), // Nov 2021
    endDate: new Date(2023, 4, 31),   // May 2023
    skills: ["SQL", "Python", "PySpark", "Databricks", "ETL", "Data Visualization"],
    achievements: ["25% data accuracy improvement", "15 hours/week automation savings"]
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    period: "2023-2025",
    title: "Master of Science - Data Science & Analytics",
    organization: "Georgetown University",
    location: "Washington, DC",
    type: "education",
    startDate: new Date(2023, 4, 1),  // May 2023
    endDate: new Date(2025, 4, 31),   // May 2025
    skills: ["Machine Learning", "Big Data", "Cloud Computing", "NLP", "Data Ethics"],
    gpa: "4.0/4.0"
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    period: "2025-Present",
    title: "Data Analyst II",
    organization: "Shift Digital",
    location: "Birmingham, MI",
    type: "professional",
    startDate: new Date(2025, 4, 1),  // May 2025
    endDate: new Date(2025, 6, 25),   // Current
    skills: ["Advanced Analytics", "Team Leadership", "Strategic Architecture"],
    achievements: ["Leading enterprise initiatives", "Mentoring junior analysts"]
  }
];

// Chart configuration
const config = {
  margin: { top: 40, right: 150, bottom: 60, left: 60 },
  width: 1000,
  height: 500,
  colors: {
    education: "#3498db",
    professional: "#2ecc71",
    background: "#f8f9fa",
    text: "#2c3e50",
    grid: "#ecf0f1"
  }
};

// Calculate responsive dimensions
const container = d3.select("#professional-timeline");
const containerWidth = Math.min(container.node().offsetWidth || 800, config.width);
const width = containerWidth - config.margin.left - config.margin.right;
const height = config.height - config.margin.top - config.margin.bottom;

// Create SVG
const svg = container
  .append("svg")
  .attr("width", containerWidth)
  .attr("height", config.height)
  .style("background-color", config.colors.background)
  .style("border-radius", "12px")
  .style("box-shadow", "0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)");

const g = svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${config.margin.left},${config.margin.top})`);

// Create scales
const timeExtent = d3.extent(timelineData.flatMap(d => [d.startDate, d.endDate]));
const xScale = d3.scaleTime()
  .domain(timeExtent)
  .range([0, width]);

const yScale = d3.scaleBand()
  .domain(timelineData.map(d => d.id))
  .range([0, height])
  .padding(0.3);

// Create axes
const xAxis = d3.axisBottom(xScale)
  .tickFormat(d3.timeFormat("%Y"))
  .ticks(d3.timeYear.every(1));

const yAxis = d3.axisLeft(yScale)
  .tickFormat("");

// Add grid lines
const xGrid = g.append("g")
  .attr("class", "grid")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale)
    .tickSize(-height)
    .tickFormat("")
    .ticks(d3.timeYear.every(1))
  )
  .style("opacity", 0.3);

xGrid.selectAll("line")
  .style("stroke", config.colors.grid)
  .style("stroke-width", 1);

// Add axes
g.append("g")
  .attr("class", "x-axis")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(xAxis)
  .selectAll("text")
  .style("font-size", "12px")
  .style("font-weight", "600")
  .style("fill", config.colors.text);

g.append("g")
  .attr("class", "y-axis")
  .call(yAxis);

// Create timeline bars
const bars = g.selectAll(".timeline-bar")
  .data(timelineData)
  .enter()
  .append("g")
  .attr("class", "timeline-bar");

// Add main bars
bars.append("rect")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startDate))
  .attr("y", d => yScale(d.id))
  .attr("width", d => xScale(d.endDate) - xScale(d.startDate))
  .attr("height", yScale.bandwidth())
  .attr("rx", 6)
  .style("fill", d => config.colors[d.type])
  .style("opacity", 0.8)
  .style("cursor", "pointer")
  .on("mouseover", function(event, d) {
    d3.select(this)
      .style("opacity", 1)
      .style("stroke", "#34495e")
      .style("stroke-width", 2);
    
    showTooltip(event, d);
  })
  .on("mouseout", function(event, d) {
    d3.select(this)
      .style("opacity", 0.8)
      .style("stroke", "none");
    
    hideTooltip();
  });

// Add labels
bars.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startDate) + (xScale(d.endDate) - xScale(d.startDate)) / 2)
  .attr("y", d => yScale(d.id) + yScale.bandwidth() / 2)
  .attr("dy", "-0.1em")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "white")
  .style("font-size", "11px")
  .style("font-weight", "600")
  .style("pointer-events", "none")
  .text(d => d.title);

bars.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => xScale(d.startDate) + (xScale(d.endDate) - xScale(d.startDate)) / 2)
  .attr("y", d => yScale(d.id) + yScale.bandwidth() / 2)
  .attr("dy", "1em")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("fill", "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)")
  .style("font-size", "9px")
  .style("font-weight", "500")
  .style("pointer-events", "none")
  .text(d => d.organization);

// Add side labels
bars.append("text")
  .attr("x", width + 10)
  .attr("y", d => yScale(d.id) + yScale.bandwidth() / 2)
  .attr("dy", "0.35em")
  .style("fill", config.colors.text)
  .style("font-size", "12px")
  .style("font-weight", "600")
  .text(d => d.period);

// Add legend
const legend = svg.append("g")
  .attr("class", "legend")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${containerWidth - 140}, 20)`);

const legendData = [
  { type: "education", label: "Education" },
  { type: "professional", label: "Professional" }
];

const legendItems = legend.selectAll(".legend-item")
  .data(legendData)
  .enter()
  .append("g")
  .attr("class", "legend-item")
  .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0, ${i * 25})`);

legendItems.append("rect")
  .attr("width", 15)
  .attr("height", 15)
  .attr("rx", 3)
  .style("fill", d => config.colors[d.type]);

legendItems.append("text")
  .attr("x", 20)
  .attr("y", 12)
  .style("fill", config.colors.text)
  .style("font-size", "12px")
  .style("font-weight", "500")
  .text(d => d.label);

// Tooltip functions
function showTooltip(event, d) {
  const tooltip = d3.select("body")
    .append("div")
    .attr("class", "professional-tooltip")
    .style("position", "absolute")
    .style("background", "rgba(0,0,0,0.95)")
    .style("color", "white")
    .style("padding", "15px")
    .style("border-radius", "8px")
    .style("font-size", "13px")
    .style("line-height", "1.4")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)")
    .style("z-index", "1000")
    .style("max-width", "300px")
    .style("opacity", 0);

  let content = `
    <div style="border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); padding-bottom: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px;">
      <strong style="font-size: 14px;">${d.title}</strong><br/>
      <span style="color: #3498db;">${d.organization}</span><br/>
      <span style="font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.8;">${d.location} • ${d.period}</span>
    </div>
  `;

  if (d.skills) {
    content += `<div style="margin-bottom: 8px;"><strong>Key Skills:</strong><br/>${d.skills.join(", ")}</div>`;
  }

  if (d.achievements) {
    content += `<div style="margin-bottom: 8px;"><strong>Achievements:</strong><br/>• ${d.achievements.join("<br/>• ")}</div>`;
  }

  if (d.gpa) {
    content += `<div><strong>GPA:</strong> ${d.gpa}</div>`;
  }

  tooltip.html(content)
    .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
    .style("top", (event.pageY - 15) + "px")
    .transition()
    .duration(200)
    .style("opacity", 1);
}

function hideTooltip() {
  d3.selectAll(".professional-tooltip").remove();
}

// Add title
svg.append("text")
  .attr("x", containerWidth / 2)
  .attr("y", 25)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "16px")
  .style("font-weight", "700")
  .style("fill", config.colors.text)
  .text("Professional Journey Timeline");

// Add animation
bars.selectAll("rect")
  .style("width", 0)
  .transition()
  .duration(1000)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 200)
  .style("width", d => xScale(d.endDate) - xScale(d.startDate));

bars.selectAll("text")
  .style("opacity", 0)
  .transition()
  .duration(500)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)
  .style("opacity", 1);
</script>
:::
